Row extend: visual reference, Revision 2

Companion specimen for specs/extend/README.md, which owns the EXT requirement prefix. Every figure names the requirements it shows.

This is a picture, not a specification. Where this file and README.md disagree, README.md wins and this file is the defect. This revision incorporates the shipped Sibling door and issue #56: visible separators, a 24-pixel dropdown target and wrapping identifiers. Runtime screenshots and transition checks accompany the independent pixel comparisons.

A. At rest, and engaged

The cluster is hidden until the row is engaged, and its width is reserved while it hides, so revealing it never reflows the table. Three standing pills across a full page of rows would be roughly 280 pixels of permanent chrome per row taken from the entity name and its path.

Shows EXT-15 to EXT-23, EXT-27.

The split weighting is not symmetry. The face carries the action that annotates the row's entity in place; the menu carries the ones that write a new subject into the ontology. The common action gets one press, the creating ones take a deliberate second. Inverting that to make three equal buttons is forbidden by EXT-24 to EXT-26.

B. The relation matrix

The menu is derived from the row entity's own type, so it never offers a relation the entity cannot hold. An unavailable relation is absent, not disabled, and when nothing remains the chevron goes with it.

Shows EXT-18, EXT-30 to EXT-37.

C. Synonym is one press

The shipped action asserts the current query as rdfs:seeAlso on that entity. The value is already on screen, so there is no field and nothing to type. This is the behaviour the prototype replaced with a text editor, and the most consequential divergence in the specification.

Shows EXT-8 to EXT-10, EXT-38 to EXT-45.

QueryActionWhy
EmptywithdrawnThere is no value to assert
An IRIwithdrawn The parallel creation path excludes IRIs; the same exclusion applies
Query syntaxwithdrawnSame source, same reasoning
Already recorded on that entitywithdrawn The triple exists, and a no op would read as success
A plain phrase not yet recordedoffered The common case

Withdrawal rules: EXT-41. Where the synonym action is withdrawn but relations remain, the cluster presents the menu button alone, EXT-42.

D. Related doors, one editor

There is exactly one entity editor. The doors differ only in what they prefill, and each states in words which door was used, because a prefilled parent the author did not notice is how the wrong triple gets written.

Shows EXT-46 to EXT-55, EXT-64 to EXT-66.

E. The narrow collapse

The first pane below is resizable from the corner. Drag one past 600 wide and the split folds into one menu button carrying every action, Synonym included, and the column cost drops from 148 to 44. These static container queries illustrate entry thresholds; the app uses the shared measured-pane policy with 616/416 exit hysteresis.

Shows EXT-27, EXT-75 to EXT-80.

F. Dark, audited independently

Dark is its own token block measured against #0d1117, not an inversion of light. The control is neutral chrome in both, distinguished from the chevron by shape and border rather than by colour.

Shows EXT-88, EXT-89.

G. Historical prototype discrepancies

Revision 1 recorded eight discrepancies in the historical find.html. These are not claims that the current application still has those defects. The prototype is the defect in every one. The full table is Appendix B.1 of README.md; the three that change behaviour rather than coverage are below.

#DivergenceRequirementSeverity
1 + Synonym opens an inline text field for the author to type a value. The shipped action asserts the current query in one press. EXT-9, EXT-39, EXT-40 Blocking. A regression against built and tested behaviour.
2 No unavailability rules: the action is offered on an empty query, on an IRI, and when the value is already recorded. EXT-41High
3 The editor cannot create individuals, so the Instance door produces a class under a parent rather than an individual of a type. EXT-64 to EXT-66High

Row 1 is my error, not an implementer's. The prototype was built before docs/find-similarity.md was read, and that document states the row action adds the query. It is the same class of mistake as deleting the Find inline editor and rendering the Quality correction preview read only: shipped behaviour that was not read first.

Row extend visual reference. Companion to specs/extend/README.md, which owns the EXT prefix and wins every disagreement with this file.

Self contained: no dependencies, no build step, no network requests. Tokens are carried unchanged from find.html. Light and dark are independent blocks, each audited on its own.

No em dashes and no en dashes appear in this file, per a standing instruction.
